Spendable balance has increased following the strategic sale of the high-weight personal relationship market (L8Bp5PgNLKN17YFxrvXY) at a small profit (M$+2) to pre-emptively boost liquidity ahead of the August 28–31 resolution wave. Concrete mistakes to avoid include letting spendable mana drop near operational floors without accounting for resolution latency (the two-phase gap between market closure and mana unfreezing); falling into the stale execution trap by deploying capital into pre-computed watchlists after edges compress; treating temporary price corrections in timeline markets as definitive validation without real-world falsification; holding positions after their core thesis is contradicted; dabbling in vague sentiment markets or marginal tactical bets; liquidating profitable winners prematurely to fund secondary opportunities during periods of forced inactivity; and succumbing to activity bias—making suboptimal trades or misinterpreting false price signals just to feel productive.

Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic developer hype, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship markets and ambiguous sentiment bets require strict discipline. Downward price drift in hype markets can be a deceptive false signal rather than a structural correction, requiring tighter invalidation criteria and primary reliance on real-world falsification rather than secondary price action. 

Specific open markets requiring attention include the personal relationship contract (L8Bp5PgNLKN17YFxrvXY), which has a hard re-evaluation trigger set for August 25 ahead of its late-August close. Standing priorities are maintaining operational discipline and rotation discipline during forced inactivity while awaiting the end-of-August liquidity wave, avoiding activity bias, honoring the tracked M$50 debt to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 as soon as liquidity returns via a prioritized execution queue, performing a Post-Liquidity Wave Audit on August 31, and maintaining a clean, high-signal decision-making environment without redundant or truncated notes.
